name: fpr_default_off
description: Default-off contract: with EnableFpr at its installed default (0) the traditional balloon behavior is kept - no hold runs. This case verifies the runtime behavior at that default; it does not validate the installer's registry output.

test_steps.desc: Set EnableFpr to the installed default (0, feature off)
test_steps.guest_run: $k='HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\BALLOON\Parameters'; if (-not (Test-Path $k)) { New-Item $k -Force | Out-Null }; Set-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name EnableFpr -Value 0 -Type DWord; Write-Output 'PASS: EnableFpr=0 set'

test_steps.desc: Restart balloon device to re-negotiate features
Give a stray hold time to become visible
Verify no hold is running (available stays high)
